training_data: MM-Fit RGB reprocessed with MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite
HAA500 selected fitness and hard-negative clips reprocessed with MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite
license_note: MM-Fit Zenodo record 7607736 is CC BY 4.0. HAA500 retains its upstream research-use terms; verify redistribution terms before shipping these derived weights outside the competition prototype.
limitations: This model is a candidate and must not replace the stable default before the real-video acceptance gate passes.
HAA500 evaluation clips are short and several added classes have low test support.
Jump-rope and running-in-place validation recall are still weak.
Pose-only input cannot reliably distinguish equipment-dependent actions such as battle rope; RGB or Video LLM evidence is required.
Fine-grained one-arm push-up, side-lunge and crunch labels are intentionally mapped to broader pose families.
Real video-call lighting, occlusion, camera placement and multi-person scenes still require team-recorded evaluation.
